name: divide-conquer
description: Split a large task into independent subtasks, delegate them to child sessions for parallel execution, and merge the results. Use when a task can be broken into non-overlapping pieces that don't depend on each other's output. Not for consensus/review (use consensus-delegation) or benchmarks (use bench). Triggers: "분할 정복", "병렬 처리", "대량 문서 요약", "문서 수십 개 요약", "여러 개를 빠르게", "parallel execution", "split and process", "summarize all of these quickly".
